notes.title: Concept Test - Re:Agent
notes.content:
Hi guys, we are making this announcement to let you know that this project is released as a proof of concept. It is likely to have errors, but it is what has been achieved with the effort of a small team that with little budget achieved what you can see. We hope you like it and all feedback will be welcome, but know in advance that we will have to put this project on stand-by until we can get more funding to move forward. 

Thanks for the support and we hope to continue progressing to achieve our dreams.
